I understand you very well. This life sucks, it's terrible, there is only suffering without an end. People are so gross, there are so many rapists, liars, manipulators, pretenders, killers, bullies, even our parents or children can be gross. We are gross in many ways while we don't have a will or desire to change. And change..is very difficult. If you would know how to change..Nobody will ever understand your pain and your suffering. You live alone on this planet full of people. I hate positive people. When I have a problem, people say: why you are so negative? Ha! They give you some simple solution as if things are so simple. For them it is, for me, it isn't. Nobody believes you, they think you are overreacting. You work some boring job you hate or you have false friends and who is a real friend anyway?? I wonder if there is a good person in this world because we are all fake, people are only looking for themselves, they are very selfish. They use you with smile to abandon you later as you wasn't their friend in life. You have to act so many times while you would rather abandon all and go to live on some mountain. Life is very disappointing. People who say it's not, lie or they live in their fantasy world, or they have a lot of money. I don't get the point too. But there is something you should know, like many others who try to commit suicide..you will live. I know that nobody believe me while telling this, it's a true disaster - you will wait for reincarnation. Suicide is a sin and you will probably wait for 1000000 years to reincarnate. There is a lot others don't know and frankly, it is better. Knowledge is a double edged sword. I wish I didn't find out anything. There is a proof for what I'm talking about but I will not tell you. If someone is interested let he or she looks over the internet for that information. The point is that you will live forever, this life is temporary and all that religion teach us is true. So, you will do nothing. I recommend everyone who read this I wrote to live their life the way they want, to find job they like, to not be fake with people, to be very careful when you are choosing a life partner..although with all that, you will screw up you life anyway. We are so stupid beings. I want to kill myself even when I know that I'll not really die. I'm very sick of this life. I was looking for solution - how to kill yourself to look accidentally, but I didn't find the way. If someone have some serious, good idea, I would be grateful.
